This plot is small, just a small piece of my land, and I am putting sorghum on it. I have no schooling but I have farmed all my life and I know sorghum does not need as much help as teff or wheat. I will put a little fertilizer because I want a good harvest, but not too much because cash is tight and sorghum forgives a lighter hand. I have animals, so I will spread manure from the kraal, use my own seed I saved from last year, and my family can do the work ourselves on such a small plot.
